_what: The programs and packages this Workshop's tools share, each pinned by the BLAKE3 of its archive: the engine reads this file from the copy of the source (trillion-rust src/tool_runs/tools/pinned_files.rs), gives each tool row the program its first argv word names and the packages its package_files items name, and fetches each at the run that needs it. `programs` and the wheel and model entries of `packages` are written by hand from the publisher's own checksum (`checked_against`); the `node_modules/...` entries are written from package-lock.json by test-helpers/write-pinned-files.mjs and checked against it by test/pinned-files-agree-with-the-lockfile.test.mjs. `bytecode` is the command that compiles the Python of a copy once at install.
